rows.grounds: numeral element indicating the quantity eighty-four
locative plural expressing location within thousands
compound of womb and mechanism in locative plural
past passive participle describing those subjected to affliction

items.question: Within what vast multitude of womb-mechanisms are beings subjected to torment?
premises: The quantity specified is eighty-four thousand.
Beings within these locations are tormented.
items.inference: Beings suffer torment across an immense array of eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
uncertainties: The grammatical subject of pīḍitāḥ is not explicitly stated in this verse and must be inferred from context.
items.plain_english: They are tormented in the eighty-four thousand womb-mechanisms.
